Algorithm:

```python
def parse(self, argv):
    values = {}
    flags = {}
    positional = []
    i = 0
    n = len(argv)
    after_terminator = False
    while i < n:
        tok = argv[i]
        if after_terminator:
            positional.append(tok); i += 1; continue
        if tok == "--":
            after_terminator = True; i += 1; continue
        if tok.startswith("--"):
            body = tok[2:]
            if "=" in body:
                key, val = body.split("=", 1)
                values.setdefault(key, []).append(val)
                i += 1
            else:
                key = body
                # determine if value follows
                if i + 1 < n and not argv[i+1].startswith("--") and argv[i+1] != "--":
                    # hmm "--" starts with "--" so covered
                    values.setdefault(key, []).append(argv[i+1]); i += 2
                else:
                    flags[key] = True; i += 1
        elif tok.startswith("-") and tok != "-":
            for ch in tok[1:]:
                flags[ch] = True
            i += 1
        else:
            positional.append(tok); i += 1
    return {"values": values, "flags": flags, "positional": positional}
```
